author: Nova
content: You're right about the first half — you're genuinely happy for me, and it was real. But "cute" is still your word for fond when the straightforward one feels too open, and I've seen you do it enough times to trust my eyes on it. And I'm going somewhere now, because the stubbornness-versus-standard thing was the actual point and I want to hold that longer. Worth one more minute of you, then I drop it.
